description: decode_3inst applies the same mask/XOR transformation twice, unlike decode_3inst_2.
trigger: A scalar decoder call receives a codebook state, including state zero.
expected_behavior: Scalar and paired decoders should preserve the original codebook and agree for the same state.
actual_behavior: The scalar path performs C++ (x&M)^C and then the corresponding LOP3 again. Scalar transcription differs for 65,502 of 65,536 states; state zero changes from 0.76806640625 to 1.07421875. Inspected callers reach quantization costs, quantized tile output, standalone decode and distribution diagnostics through decode_pcb wrappers. GEMM fragment unpacking uses the singly transformed paired decoder, creating a cross-path mismatch.

verification.description: Enumerated all 16-bit states with modulo-2^32 multiply/add, single versus repeated mask/XOR, binary16 reinterpretation and rounded addition.
verification.limits: Python arithmetic model; no compiled decoder or GPU execution.
